entities.name: PMID:25452597
observations: Circulating NT-proANP genetic association study reports replicated variants in the MTHFR-CLCN6-NPPA-NPPB locus and evaluates stroke risk; title specifies the stroke association in whites.

entities.name: rs5063 stroke risk
observations: In the reported community study, NPPA rs5063 carriers had lower NT-proANP (1427 vs 2291 pmol/L) and higher stroke risk than wild-type subjects (adjusted HR 1.6, P=0.004); 33 genome-wide significant variants in MTHFR-CLCN6-NPPA-NPPB replicated.
